author: Hebrish
description:
Hebrish TTS Voice Recordings
	


 
Audio dataset, standalone. Kept apart from the master dataset and its split-outs. Every audio dataset as one tree, with hours: the audio index. How every dataset fits together: the dataset index.


Single-speaker read and spontaneous speech for training a text-to-speech voice that code-switches
between English and Hebrew ("Hebrish") the way an English-speaking immigrant in Israel does.
